reference_runtime.environment: OpenAI reference Python / Decimal and float probes

records.reason: If p/q and p'/q' are equal rationals but (p,q)!=(p',q') as integer-lattice vectors, position/norm dependent operations can differ. As stated this follows from changing the mathematical object/representation; a nontrivial theorem requires a precisely defined quotient/embedding and operator class.
records.repair: State the exact maps S and P and prove a noncommutation theorem with hypotheses stronger than vector inequality.
records.close_prior_art: Representation/encoding dependence is an established formal topic; see Lim & Ziegler, Quantitative Coding and Complexity Theory of Continuous Data, arXiv:2002.04005.

records.formal_result: For c=sqrt(3)/2 and R_n=c^(F_n), Fibonacci recurrence gives R_(n+1)=R_n*R_(n-1) and R_(n+1)/R_n=R_(n-1).
records.repair: Search for and prove a genuinely non-derived invariant; quasicrystal analogy is not evidence by itself.

records.reason: Typological/language distances, cross-lingual embedding alignment and their relationship to transfer performance are already active research areas. The authorial term/metric can remain testable, but novelty requires incremental predictive value and directional asymmetry beyond existing distances/alignment measures.

records.correction: Subgraph isomorphism is a classical hard graph-matching problem; semantic graph representations and graph-based machine translation are also established. Complexity of the proposed translation problem does not follow until the language-to-graph mapping, reduction direction, decision/search problem and verification input are fixed.
records.scope_guard: If an explicit node mapping is supplied, checking preservation is polynomial; if correspondence must be found, the matching problem is different. Do not claim a complexity class until input specification is formalized.

records.counterexample: s_(t+1)=(1-alpha^2)s_t+alpha*x_t for 0<alpha<1 is first-order, linear, one-parameter, stable in the state coefficient, persistent and input-sensitive, but is not the claimed EMA rule.
records.repair: Add a formal constant-input fixed-point/fidelity axiom and define equivalence under parameter reparameterization. Then prove the narrower characterization theorem rather than absolute uniqueness.

records.reason: Concept/semantic representations as attractor states have decades of neural-network prior art. A multilingual perturbation basin-size proxy may still be a specific empirical construction, but the core attractor interpretation is not novel by itself.

Morphosyntactic/language-processing differences already produce measurable EEG/ERP differences in primary studies. The proposed combined grammar->HRV/EEG/GSR cross-language design remains a testable experimental extension, not a new general principle by default.

Semantic entropy and information-emergence metrics already quantify meaning-aware uncertainty/semantic organization. Naming a metric syntropy is insufficient; it must be mathematically defined and add preregistered information beyond these baselines.
records.scope_guard: No thermodynamic equivalence is allowed without physical variables, units and model.

records.reason: Computability/complexity can depend strongly on representations/encodings, especially for continuous data; this is established theory. A specific engineering theorem or counterexample can still be an application contribution.
